business_scope: static beginner-to-advanced Go CPU and memory performance lesson for fictional IM in-memory acceptance latency
prerequisites: 05.06–05.07 Go memory lifecycle and garbage collection
first_pass: distinguish CPU seconds, wall time, cgroup quota and goroutine waiting
calculate per-request allocation rate in KiB and MiB
separate cumulative allocations, live heap and RSS
keep S2 in-memory acceptance separate from proposed S3 and future device delivery
second_pass: choose CPU, alloc, heap, block, mutex or trace based on a falsifiable hypothesis
use an explicitly simplified effective allocation budget to reason about GC frequency
explain GOGC and GOMEMLIMIT CPU-memory tradeoffs and soft-limit boundaries
review copy removal or pooling for ownership, concurrency, peak memory and business correctness
limit OpenIM conclusions to inspected fixed source paths
not_yet_prerequisites: learner's actual controlled Go profiles and runtime measurements
